principles.name: Domain first
principles.detail: Keep business rules independent from hosting and framework choices.

principles.name: Contracts over coupling
principles.detail: Use explicit API and integration contracts with validation and authorization boundaries.

principles.name: Data discipline
principles.detail: Treat schema, migrations, indexing, and performance as deployable application concerns.

principles.name: Production by design
principles.detail: Build health checks, logging, configuration, CI/CD, and deployment paths into the system.
